title: Harmonized Landsat–Sentinel-2 separability over lakes and campaign-level validation of satellite Secchi depth in Lake Titicaca: analysis code
description: Analysis code, satellite reflectance extracted at each match-up and aggregate results for a study of Landsat 8/9 and Sentinel-2 interchangeability over lake water (NASA HLS v2.0) and of campaign-level validation of Secchi depth retrieval in Lake Titicaca. In-situ data belong to IMARPE and are not included.
